One harness component owns the standing goal and the automatic lock, computes the top layer from (conversation live, browser busy) and issues only the transition intents: a conversation takes the head from browsing, browsing resumes on fade if the browse is still running, and wandering resumes when both end (q5).

obligations.behavior: recognised first, biggest among equals; a single unknown face still yields a bbox
obligations.source_text: When several faces are in frame the runtime prefers an enrolled (recognised) face for face_bbox: reachy/behavior/face_sense.py select_face today picks the biggest face and lets recognition break only a near tie; it changes to recognised-first, biggest among equals (q2). reachy-mini-cli change on wireless-motor-enable and main.

obligations.behavior: cold nameless replies dropped like quiet; a name opens 45 s; injects and utterances renew
obligations.source_text: Cold/warm attention window (q7): Nova is cold until a USER transcript names her ('nova', 'reachy', and the mishearings 'richie', 'reach', 'noah', matched with the runtime's is_name_match rules restated locally, cite-don't-import); a name opens a warm window of NOVA_ATTENTION_WINDOW_S (default 45 s, the runtime's Limits.attention_window_s) that every further USER transcript or Nova utterance renews. While cold, a Nova utterance generated in reply to a nameless transcript is dropped at the speaker exactly as a timed-quiet drop is (speaking.py's quiet gate: no playback, no gate arm, one named senselog line), while an utterance that follows a body cue or a tool result (an inject) within the same few seconds still plays. The mic feed to Sonic stays ungated so the name is always heard and barge-in keeps working. Kill switch NOVA_ATTENTION_GATE (default on).

obligations.behavior: a gate-dropped reply is not appended to the ledger
obligations.source_text: Challenge / adjacent-systems (harness/ledger.py, memory_compactor.py): a reply dropped by the attention gate is excluded from the ledger and so from the day's memory, the same way quiet-window utterances already are (Ledger's quiet-aware append) — otherwise the compactor distils lines nobody heard and the history replay tells the next session Nova said things she never said aloud.

obligations.seam: head reflexes under a held head
obligations.behavior: browsing inhibits orient-to-sound and nod; nova-face-noticed tombstoned
obligations.source_text: Challenge / adjacent-systems (device rules.toml + default_rules.toml + arbitration.py): while the harness holds the head for browsing or conversation, the runtime's own head reflexes are kept off it — the nova-managed rule nova-face-noticed (face -> nod, 2 s, in the device overlay) and the shipped look-toward-sound (orient-to-sound, 12 s) would take the head from a stoppable gaze-hold by recency. The browsing layer inhibits orient-to-sound and nod through set_inhibition merged with the current set (tools.py's later-wins merge), the face lock already inhibits feel-alive and orient-to-sound, and nova-face-noticed is retired from the overlay (tombstoned through rules_overlay, enabled=false): a nod at every recognised face is the wrong reflex once the lock exists.

obligations.behavior: release_face and declare_goal None on start and on stop
obligations.source_text: Challenge / lifecycle (supervisor.py stop_event; runtime face_lock.py mind-offline release): the harness releases what it holds — on stop_event the gaze stack submits release_face (when owner is auto) and declare_goal None, and on start it submits both once (idempotent; 'not locked' is ok:true) — because the runtime's mind-offline release is inert on this device ('mind presence dropped reason=client-incompatible' at every runtime start), so a crashed harness would otherwise leave the head locked until the 1800 s max-hold.

obligations.behavior: backoff 3/6/12/24/30 s, one summary line, ok:null retried as unknown
obligations.source_text: Challenge / failure-mode (dead camera, refused locks): lock_face retries inside a conversation back off 3, 6, 12 s up to 30 s, a conversation that never sees a face logs one 'no face known' summary line rather than one per retry, and a degraded spool answer (ok: null, the 1 s await timeout the flapping engine heartbeat produces) counts as unknown and is retried, never as locked.

obligations.behavior: three producer threads, one serial op sequence
obligations.source_text: Challenge / concurrency (three producer threads): the gaze stack is single-writer — Sonic's response thread (transcript, speaking edge), the speaker worker (idle) and the browser worker (state) only set flags under a lock; one worker thread computes the target layer and issues spool ops serially, waiting out each 1 s await before the next, so lock, release and goal calls can never interleave or reorder.

obligations.behavior: one latched no-frames line after 60 s without frames, one restored line, eyes in status
obligations.source_text: Challenge / observability (runtime reports 'available' for a camera that has produced no frame since boot): the harness names a dead camera — it samples reachy/events/sense/snapshot at about 1 Hz and after 60 s of frame_available=false logs one latched '[SENSE stage=vision source=runtime event=frames] dropped reason=no-frames' line (and one 'restored' line when frames return), and supervisor.status() carries eyes: live|dead|unknown. Without this, item 2 fails silently in exactly the way this pass found it.

obligations.behavior: a must-deliver inject during the session gap is queued and sent once with its age
obligations.source_text: Challenge / adjacent-systems (nova_sonic.py session restart and rotation): a must-deliver inject (a browse result) arriving while Sonic is between sessions — inject_text answers 'dropped-inactive' during the 1-3 s restart or rotation gap — is queued and sent with its age once the next session is listening; today it would be lost exactly like the throttled one.

obligations.behavior: effectful tools refused 'not addressed' while cold and nameless; read-only tools allowed
obligations.source_text: Challenge / security-and-cost lens (tools.py IntentTools.execute): while cold, tool calls Sonic makes in reply to a nameless transcript are refused with the named reason 'not addressed' for the effectful tools (browse, forge, use_skill, author_rule, goto, run_behavior, declare_goal, set_mode, set_inhibition, create_rule, enroll_face, lock_face) so ambient talk cannot start an AgentCore session or move the body; read-only and quiet tools (recall_senses, stay_silent, end_silence, raise/lower/set voice, release_face) stay allowed.

obligations.behavior: the camera state at acceptance is recorded from a live sample; item-2 live checks are blocked, never assumed
obligations.source_text: Challenge / reversibility-and-ops (runtime restart 07:13 BST 2026-09-06): a runtime restart is not a camera recovery on this device — the receive pipeline fails at media acquisition with 'GStreamer pipeline error (gst-core-error-quark code=4): state change failed' and frame_available stays false (435/435, then 171/171 snapshots) while /dev/video0-1 are held by the daemon's processes; item 2's live acceptance is blocked on the runtime/daemon media path (reachy-mini-cli issue filed), and the harness side of item 2 ships behind NOVA_FACE_HOLD regardless, verified by unit tests against a fake spool until the camera returns.
